Celebrations in Smoke#447.src: If you will entertain an old woman, then I have no use for you. Quit blocking my view.
Celebrations in Smoke#447.dst: 如果你愿意陪一个老太婆消遣，那我对你就没什么用处了。别挡着我的视线。
Celebrations in Smoke#447.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#448.src: My investigator has returned. Now, tell me what you know.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.dst: 我的调查员回来了。现在，告诉我你知道些什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#448.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#449.src: You look like you have something on your mind, what is it?
Celebrations in Smoke#449.dst: 你看起来有心事，是什么？
Celebrations in Smoke#449.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#450.src: Ah, I see your investigations have borne fruit.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.dst: 啊，看来你的调查有成果了。
Celebrations in Smoke#450.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#451.src: Yes. As you have seen, people tend to let their guard down at the festival in a way they normally wouldn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#451.dst: 是的。如你所见，人们在庆典上往往会以平时不会有的方式放松警惕。
Celebrations in Smoke#451.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#452.src: They are a necessity to ensure any unexpected guests are swiftly taken care of.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.dst: 他们是确保任何不速之客都能被迅速处理的必要存在。
Celebrations in Smoke#452.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#453.src: I suspect you're probably right. And yet, that is irrelevant.
Celebrations in Smoke#453.dst: 我想你大概说得对。然而，那无关紧要。
Celebrations in Smoke#453.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#454.src: You will tell me they are reckless and a danger to others. I don't disagree, but I encourage you to look at the wider picture.
Celebrations in Smoke#454.dst: 你会跟我说他们鲁莽，对别人很危险。我不反对，但我鼓励你看看更大的局面。
Celebrations in Smoke#454.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#455.src: If we let up our vigilance for even a moment, we have already lost our war. Our clans and families will be infiltrated within the day.
Celebrations in Smoke#455.dst: 只要我们有片刻松懈，就已经输掉了这场战争。我们的氏族和家庭一天之内就会被渗透。
Celebrations in Smoke#455.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#456.src: Their recklessness prevents this. In a case where the smallest failure would be a catastrophe, recklessness becomes necessity.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.dst: 他们的鲁莽防止了这种事。在最小的失误都会酿成灾难的情况下，鲁莽就成了必要。
Celebrations in Smoke#456.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#457.src: Imagine they had not acted rashly in throwing the bottle of fuel onto the already lit flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.dst: 想象一下，如果他们没有冒失地把那瓶燃料扔到已经点着的火上。
Celebrations in Smoke#457.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#458.src: They did not create the flame, someone else must have been hoping to gain from it.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.dst: 火不是他们放的，一定是别人想从中得利。
Celebrations in Smoke#458.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#459.src: Their actions, while dangerous, prevented any fiends from exploiting the opportunity. We took it out of their control.
Celebrations in Smoke#459.dst: 他们的行动虽然危险，却防止了任何恶徒利用这个机会。我们把局面从他们手中夺了回来。
Celebrations in Smoke#459.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#460.src: Whatever risk their actions created was worth the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#460.dst: 无论他们的行动带来什么风险，都值得这个代价。
Celebrations in Smoke#460.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#461.src: Apologies for rambling, I assure you though that safety is our top concern. Whatever the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#461.dst: 抱歉我说了这么多，不过我向你保证，安全是我们的首要考量。不惜任何代价。
Celebrations in Smoke#461.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#462.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的庆典主办人那里，或再多调查一下嫌疑人。

Celebrations in Smoke#463.src: You think you know who the changeling is?
Celebrations in Smoke#463.dst: 你觉得你知道谁是易形者了？
Celebrations in Smoke#463.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#464.src: You've dug into them all and have found something? Excellent.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.dst: 你把他们全都查过一遍，发现了什么？太好了。
Celebrations in Smoke#464.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#465.src: So, who do you think tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#465.dst: 那么，你认为是谁想烧掉柳条人？
Celebrations in Smoke#465.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#466.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.dst: 嫌疑人 {~}？很好。接下来就交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#466.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#467.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#467.dst: 再次非常感谢你的帮忙。你在这件事上的协助让庆典得以成功举办，我怎么强调都不为过。
Celebrations in Smoke#467.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#468.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典，一定要看柳条人燃烧！我会在前排为你留个特别的座位，聊表谢意。
Celebrations in Smoke#468.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#469.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.dst: 嫌疑人 {~}？很好。接下来就交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#469.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#470.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.dst: 再次非常感谢你的帮忙。你在这件事上的协助让庆典得以成功举办，我怎么强调都不为过。
Celebrations in Smoke#470.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#471.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典，一定要看柳条人燃烧！我会在前排为你留个特别的座位，聊表谢意。
Celebrations in Smoke#471.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#472.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.dst: 嫌疑人 {~}？很好。接下来就交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#472.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#473.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.dst: 再次非常感谢你的帮忙。你在这件事上的协助让庆典得以成功举办，我怎么强调都不为过。
Celebrations in Smoke#473.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#474.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典，一定要看柳条人燃烧！我会在前排为你留个特别的座位，聊表谢意。
Celebrations in Smoke#474.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#475.src: I understand your reticense to pick one. We don't have anything close to the information required to make a proper judgement.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.dst: 我理解你不愿意选一个。我们手上的情报远远不足以做出正确的判断。
Celebrations in Smoke#475.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#476.src: But you cannot allow that to stop you. We do not have the luxury to close our eyes and pretend it didn't happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.dst: 但你不能因此停下。我们没有闭上眼睛、假装什么都没发生的余裕。
Celebrations in Smoke#476.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#477.src: Please, from the inevitably incomplete investigation you conducted, tell me who you think lit that flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.dst: 拜托，根据你那必然不完整的调查，告诉我你认为是谁点的火。
Celebrations in Smoke#477.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#478.src: Very well then. I am disappointed, but understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.dst: 很好。我很失望，但我能理解。
Celebrations in Smoke#478.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#479.src: I will take care of things from this point forward.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.dst: 从现在起，这件事交给我处理。
Celebrations in Smoke#479.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#480.src: In thanks for saving the wickerman, there will be a seat saved for you when you are ready to watch it burn.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.dst: 为了感谢你救下柳条人，等你准备好观看它燃烧时，会有一个座位为你保留。
Celebrations in Smoke#480.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#481.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#481.dst: 好好享受剩下的庆典吧。
Celebrations in Smoke#481.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#482.src: Keep looking then. Return here once you've made a decision.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.dst: 那就继续调查吧。做好决定再回来这里。
Celebrations in Smoke#482.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#485.src: You children of the {p} gather round
Celebrations in Smoke#485.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#486.src: To gaze upon this relic from years past,
Celebrations in Smoke#486.dst: 凝望这件来自往昔岁月的遗物，
Celebrations in Smoke#486.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#487.src: This effigy, of ancient foes we fought—
Celebrations in Smoke#487.dst: 这尊人偶，是我们曾经对抗的古老宿敌——
Celebrations in Smoke#487.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#488.src: In memory, we will again ignite!
Celebrations in Smoke#488.dst: 为了铭记，我们将再次将它点燃！
Celebrations in Smoke#488.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#489.src: An ancient beast, rebuilt with plant and straw,
Celebrations in Smoke#489.dst: 一头古老的野兽，以草木与稻秆重塑，
Celebrations in Smoke#489.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#490.src: What once was flesh, reconstitute as wood;
Celebrations in Smoke#490.dst: 昔日的血肉，如今化作木头重生；
Celebrations in Smoke#490.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#491.src: All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
Celebrations in Smoke#491.dst: 一切怪物，无论新旧，都必须迎来终结——
Celebrations in Smoke#491.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#492.src: All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
Celebrations in Smoke#492.dst: 一切恶徒都必须焚烧！必须炙烤、焦黑、熔化！
Celebrations in Smoke#492.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#493.src: Substance beside, all that remains persists...
Celebrations in Smoke#493.dst: 形体之外，残存的一切依然留存……
Celebrations in Smoke#493.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#494.src: ...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
Celebrations in Smoke#494.dst: ……化作焦黑的尸骸，再不能构成威胁！
Celebrations in Smoke#494.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#495.src: Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
Celebrations in Smoke#495.dst: 噢，你好，我一直没机会谢谢你。
Celebrations in Smoke#495.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#496.src: I'm not sure what happened after you left.
Celebrations in Smoke#496.dst: 我不太清楚你走之后发生了什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#496.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#497.src: The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
Celebrations in Smoke#497.dst: 庆典主办人回来，把 Burick/Cerisa 带走了。
Celebrations in Smoke#497.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#498.src: I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
Celebrations in Smoke#498.dst: 我不知道发生了什么，不过，呃，我觉得不是好事。
Celebrations in Smoke#498.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#499.src: So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
Celebrations in Smoke#499.dst: 所以，再次谢谢你。当时我脑子一团乱，没能好好表达。
Celebrations in Smoke#499.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#501.src: I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
Celebrations in Smoke#501.dst: 我会看看能在这附近待多久，不过当地人已经开始有点瞪我了。
Celebrations in Smoke#501.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#502.src: I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
Celebrations in Smoke#502.dst: 我可能会试着往树林更深处去，看看能找到什么。
Celebrations in Smoke#502.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#503.src: Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
Celebrations in Smoke#503.dst: 或者去参军？我觉得我不会很擅长，甚至不觉得他们会收我，但也许值得一试。
Celebrations in Smoke#503.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#504.src: Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
Celebrations in Smoke#504.dst: 不然，我就只能靠找到的东西过活了。我，呃，不太看好自己的机会。
Celebrations in Smoke#504.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#505.src: I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
Celebrations in Smoke#505.dst: 我是！我一直都，呃，有点紧张。不过比那时候好多了。
Celebrations in Smoke#505.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#506.src: It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#506.dst: 多亏了你，感觉就像压在我脖子上的斧头被拿开了。
Celebrations in Smoke#506.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#507.src: There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.dst: 还是有很多不确定，但我不再觉得自己像笼子里乱窜的兔子了。
Celebrations in Smoke#507.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#508.src: I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.dst: 我那时候还有点恍惚，所以没怎么注意，抱歉。
Celebrations in Smoke#508.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#509.src: She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
Celebrations in Smoke#509.dst: 不过她走得很快，一定是急着去什么地方
Celebrations in Smoke#509.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#511.src: Hello. Please try not to come too close.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#512.src: We can talk from a distance.
Celebrations in Smoke#512.dst: 我们可以隔着距离说话。
Celebrations in Smoke#512.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#513.src: Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.dst: 抱歉这么冷淡，你的帮忙我很感激。
Celebrations in Smoke#513.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#514.src: But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.dst: 但我无法确定你就是你说的那个人。
Celebrations in Smoke#514.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#516.src: Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
Celebrations in Smoke#516.dst: 自从我们在庆典上碰面之后，我一直比平常更低调。
Celebrations in Smoke#516.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#517.src: My life has not been much different than it usually is.
Celebrations in Smoke#517.dst: 我的生活跟平时没什么两样。
Celebrations in Smoke#517.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#518.src: It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#518.dst: 去参加庆典本身就是个可怕的错误。
Celebrations in Smoke#518.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#519.src: I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
Celebrations in Smoke#519.dst: 我让自己被人性左右了；在 {p}，这种错误很少能轻易了事。
Celebrations in Smoke#519.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#520.src: I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
Celebrations in Smoke#520.dst: 我不会再犯同样的错。寂寞会伤人，但信任会杀人。
Celebrations in Smoke#520.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#521.src: Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#521.dst: 我最后一次看到的时候，他们还在 {p}。
Celebrations in Smoke#521.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#522.src: They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
Celebrations in Smoke#522.dst: 他们看起来不是当拾荒者的料，要是找不到在氏族之外生活的其他办法，一个星期内就会没命。
Celebrations in Smoke#522.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#524.src: Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
Celebrations in Smoke#524.dst: 是的，趁大家都在看柳条人燃烧的时候，她把能翻的无人摊位、包包和房子都翻了个遍。
Celebrations in Smoke#524.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#525.src: I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
Celebrations in Smoke#525.dst: 她还没翻完我就走了，不过今天早上我看到一个人影从 {p} 往南走，扛着好几个大包。
Celebrations in Smoke#525.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#526.src: Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
Celebrations in Smoke#526.dst: 不管她要去哪里，她都准备好走很远的路了。
Celebrations in Smoke#526.speaker: Burick
